name: After § 107
title: REPORT on how to secure a sustainable future for the EU livestock sector in light of the need to ensure food security, farmers’ resilience and the challenges posed by animal diseases?
part_text: 107a. Considers that the cumulative impact of the EU-Mercosur Agreement and the EU-Australia Agreement, which will substantially increase imports of beef from Mercosur countries and of beef and sheep from Australia into the EU, will put EU farmers under further strain, especially in certain sensitive product sectors, particularly in the high-quality beef sector; notes with concern that the EU-Mercosur Agreement does not ensure converging safety standards;
